newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks surge on Wall Street, election hopes.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks surge on Wall Street, election hopes.

text.p: Tokyo stocks surged in the Tuesday trading session, pushed by new record highs on Wall Street overnight as well as speculation that the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) may win a majority in the Lower House of parliament in Japan's general election on Sunday, brokers said.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 jumped 400.68 points or 1.91 percent to close at 21,429.93. Its December futures leapt 360 points to 21,490.
"The Dow closed at over 6,000 and the domestic political picture is coming into focus with the LDP seen at the nucleus," said Yamaichi Securities general manager Tadahiro Kamogawa.
